name: Prismburl
description: Both hands are set on the cudgel a span apart, one to hold and one to turn, and the guard covers the head.

name: Girthtriumph
description: The forward hand snaps the cudgel's head out in a quick rap while the rear hand stays braced.

name: Squall Belabor
description: The cudgel passes between the hands as the student steps, so each stride begins a new stroke.

name: Squallthump
description: The grip is reversed mid-swing so the stroke comes in from the other side with fresh force.

name: Peal Heartwood
description: One palm braces the shaft while the other turns it, and the blow slides off to the outside.

name: Unbending Clout
description: The cudgel and free hand close like a pair of jaws on the opponent's wrist and hold it still.

name: Ruling Burl
description: Both hands haul on the cudgel hooked behind the opponent's guard and drag him off his feet.

name: Steel Roundhead
description: Both hands drive the cudgel down with all the student's strength and qi, crashing through any single guard.

name: Girthbanner
description: Strokes pass from hand to hand in a steady rhythm that leaves no gap for a counter.

name: Valiant Cudgel
description: With both hands clasped tight on the cudgel, the field's weight is delivered in one unanswerable blow.

name: Heroic Quenched Knob
description: The school's own stroke, in which both hands move as a single will and the force gathered scales to the student's realm.

name: Girthpledge
description: Feet spread wide and knees soft, the student's weight settles low like water in a shallow dish.

name: Thumpbanner
description: A light rap sends a ripple of shock out from the point of contact along the limb.

name: Knobgrace
description: The student walks the edge of the opponent's reach, a circle that keeps the club just outside.

name: Inviolate Bulge
description: A wide, open parry spreads the force of a strike across the length of the club.

name: Handholdgrip Verdict
description: Qi spreads from a single blow through the body in rings, numbing a wider part of the limb.

name: Ruling Wallop
description: The club rests on the opponent's guard with steady, even pressure that quiets his movement.

name: Stout Covenant
description: The knob catches the opponent's lead foot like a shoal catching a hull, and he stumbles.

name: Staunch Bellyswell
description: Qi settles down through the legs like silt through water, so the student cannot be moved.

name: Solarknob
description: Weight is gathered into the club, then the whole stance tips and spills the force across everything ahead.

name: Bedrock Thump
description: A hammer blow from above strikes where the footing is shallowest and breaks the opponent's stance.

name: Peerless Bludgeon
description: A light-seeming stroke of the field carries its force deep into the body beneath the guard.

name: Steelgirth
description: The school's own stroke, gathering force broad and shallow and tipping it all out at once, in measure with the student's realm.

name: Girthtroth
description: Arms spread wide with the club across the back of the shoulders, the student presents a broad guard.

name: Thunderclap Bellyswell
description: A quick rap with the club's tip strikes the hand like a feather's edge, then flicks away.

name: Gliding Thickend
description: A long gliding stride keeps the student's height steady as he closes the distance.

name: Vaunted Burl
description: Two strokes cross each other like wingbeats and meet the opponent from opposite sides.

name: Deluge Roundhead
description: A blow is let to slide along the club's surface, shed as a feather sheds water.

name: Tyrannous Cudgel
description: The club's knob snatches at the opponent's weapon or collar and jerks it out of line.

name: Squall Bludgeon
description: The student rolls over in mid-leap and dives with the club leading, striking from above.

name: Ruling Stout
description: A broad sweep of the arm and club flashes against the light and dazzles the opponent's eyes.

name: Noble Wallop
description: The spread guard snaps shut into a single plunging blow that gives the opponent no time to guard.

name: Sovereign Squall Girth
description: The school's own stoop, a plunging club stroke whose force scales to the realm of the hawk that makes it.

name: Consecrated Knob
description: The club is held across the chest in a formal greeting, closing the guard as the court convenes.

name: Noble Bulge
description: A rap along the line of the opponent's flank, as the bank runs beside the water.

name: Nimble Clout
description: Each foot is set on a firm point in turn, as on stepping stones across a river.

name: Deluge Heartwood
description: A parry carries in a small rippling motion that leads an incoming blow off to the side.

name: Squall Handholdgrip
description: A blow strikes in the middle of the opponent's advance, where his weight is carried along.

name: Peal Belabor
description: The knob hooks the opponent and draws him along the current of his own motion.

name: Statute Thickend
description: The club is planted before the student like a post at a ford, and attackers must go round it.

name: Haemal Heartwood
description: A low sweep drags the opponent's legs from under him like an undertow beneath the surface.

name: Stoutseal
description: Qi is gathered around the opponent like a court seated beside the water, and holds his limbs fast.

name: Cloutcrown
description: All gathered qi swells at once and the hammer falls like a spring flood on a river bank.

name: Noble Bellyswell
description: The whole gathered current of the field sweeps out through the club and carries all before it.

name: Majestic Squall Burl
description: The school's own stroke, ruled by the current of the fight, whose weight is set by the realm of the one who strikes.

name: Prismstout
description: Standing tall with the club lifted like a raised gavel, the student overlooks the opponent's every move.

name: Thunderclap Knob
description: Two quick raps land on the same joint along parallel lines, loosening it before the heavier stroke.

name: Twilit Bludgeon
description: A step upward onto higher ground gives the student height over his opponent for the next stroke.

name: Vigorknob
description: The high track delivers a long overhead stroke that takes its weight from the height of the lift.

name: Thickend Banner
description: The low track sends the club along the ground in a sweep that cuts down the opponent's stance.

name: Stately Roundhead
description: High and low tracks cross in front of the body and turn a blow away from either side.

name: Cudgeldecree
description: Where the two tracks meet, the student's shoulder drives into the opponent with the club's weight behind it.

name: Resonant Thump
description: High and low strokes rise together in a rapid series that lets the opponent defend only one.

name: Haemal Stout
description: The hammer falls from the full height of the lift with both tracks of qi in step.

name: Quenched Wallop
description: The field is gathered along both tracks and handed down through the club in one piercing blow.

name: Thunderclap Girth
description: The school's own stroke, twin tracks rising to one verdict, whose force is read by the striker's realm.

name: Bedrock Handholdgrip
description: The student sinks low and wide, holding the club overhead like a lid on a basin of sky.

name: Magnificent Clout
description: A rap that skims the edge of the opponent's guard and strikes the forearm like a cloud's shadow.

name: Deluge Bulge
description: A smooth flowing step carries the student forward as water pours from a tipped basin.

name: Steelwallop
description: A blow heavy as a rain-filled basin lands and drops the opponent's guard under its weight.

name: Squall Roundhead
description: A parry made with full qi so that an incoming blow spills off the club without touching the student.

name: Thump Seal
description: The knob hooks the opponent's guard and pours him down toward the ground by the arm.

name: Squall Cudgel
description: The Core's full brimming qi overflows through one strike that lands with the weight of a flooded basin.

name: Entropy Bludgeon
description: A wide sweep brings down a heavy cataract of qi on every foe within the stroke's path.

name: Wallopdecree
description: The student tips the whole basin of sky and the Core's gathered weight falls across the field.

name: Gallant Bedrock Clout
description: The school's own greatest stroke, two tracks of Core force run down one club and set by the striker's realm.

name: Bulgetroth
description: The student stands in the open with the club grounded, speaks the short oath, and does not yield.

name: Knobedict
description: A swift rap falls on the heel of the spoken oath's last word and strikes the hand.

name: Deluge Bellyswell
description: A step across open ground leans with the wind and covers distance before the opponent can set.

name: Squall Heartwood
description: The club turns an incoming blow aside at its edge, as a rock turns the course of a gust.

name: Majestic Belabor
description: A sworn overhand stroke carries qi down the club without a flicker of hesitation.

name: Thunderclap Burl
description: The club's shaft shoves the opponent with a push of qi like a wind pressing on a standing tree.

name: Thunderclap Wallop
description: The free hand opens and hooks the opponent's wrist while the club's knob closes behind the elbow.

name: Sainted Thickend
description: The student leans into an oncoming rush as into a gust, planting the club to hold the line.

name: Cudgel Edict
description: The oath is kept in a full-bodied hammer blow that cracks a guard like frozen plateau ground.

name: Burldecree
description: When the oath is made good, a gathered sweep strikes every foe who stood against it.

name: Exalted Girth
description: The oath is flung into the wind and the field carries the club's full weight down upon the foe.

name: Heroic Handholdgrip
description: The wind academies' own stroke, an oath sworn and paid in one blow, weighted to the student's realm.

name: Knob Vow
description: Quite still, as if the air itself were held, the student waits behind a low, level club.

name: Steel Belabor
description: A rap comes out of the stillness steady and hard, like a gale that has just begun to blow.

name: Fleet Bulge
description: The student stands fast, then shifts in a single step as the wind changes its quarter.

name: Vaunted Handholdgrip
description: The held breath breaks into a blow, and the stored stillness is spent in the stroke.

name: Unwavering Bulge
description: A tiny movement of the club at the last moment turns the blow, leaving the student calm.

name: Pealthump
description: The club's knob catches the opponent as the wind turns and spins him with it.

name: Girth Verdict
description: After long stillness the whole held wind stands behind a single blow and drives it home.

name: Gripping Thump
description: The student presses on the opponent's weapon arm with gale-like qi and pins it to his side.

name: Squallwallop
description: The stillest moment breaks into a fall of the field's force, heavy and complete.

name: Storied Inferno Thickend
description: The wind academies' own stroke, stillness turned to a blow whose weight follows the striker's realm.

name: Enshrined Burl
description: The student takes a line to the target, speaks it aloud, and holds the club on it.

name: Thunderclap Heartwood
description: A rap strikes straight along the sworn line to the point that was named.

name: Dauntless Stout
description: The student keeps his sworn course, stepping neither aside nor back whatever the opponent does.

name: Royal Cudgel
description: An overhand blow falls down the sworn line, qi following the oath all the way.

name: Paritygirth
description: Whatever the force of the blow, the parry returns to its bearing as soon as it has been turned.

name: Binding Roundhead
description: The club presses along the sworn line and pins the opponent's weapon against his own guard.

name: Imperial Bludgeon
description: The student crosses the opponent's line with his own and strikes at the point where they meet.

name: Wallopcrown
description: A hammer blow falls on the sworn bearing with the whole weight of the promise behind it.

name: Girthedict
description: Blows rain down the held bearing without pause and force the opponent to guard along the one line.

name: Steel Thump
description: The oath and the bearing meet in one stroke of the field that cannot be turned.

name: Valiant Quenched Clout
description: The school's own stroke, sworn upon a bearing and held to it, weighted by the striker's realm.

name: Inviolate Bellyswell
description: With one foot at the edge and an oath on the lips, the student holds the line.

name: Inferno Stout
description: A rap from the ground's rim strikes the opponent's leg and pushes his weight toward the drop.

name: Deluge Wallop
description: Steady paces along the very edge of the ground keep the opponent on the dangerous side.

name: Haemal Bulge
description: A heavy blow presses the opponent back one more pace toward the edge.

name: Steel Burl
description: The student braces on the oath he has sworn and the ground does not let him slip.

name: Peal Knob
description: The knob hooks the opponent's ankle at the line of the drop and tips him toward it.

name: Storied Girth
description: A hammer blow keeps the oath of the edge and drives the opponent hard over it.

name: Bedrock Roundhead
description: A broad gathered sweep clears the rim of the plateau of every foe standing before the student.

name: Handholdgrip Banner
description: The sworn stroke carries the field's force and hurls the opponent clear of his ground.

name: Bulgeedict
description: The school's own stroke, the edge held by oath and the blow weighted to the striker's realm.

name: Statute Bellyswell
description: The student settles into calm at the centre of the fight, club level and breath slow.

name: Bedrock Belabor
description: A rap comes from perfect calm and strikes the opponent's guard where he least expects it.

name: Belabor Solace
description: A hushed step closes the distance without a sound or a stir of the air.

name: Peal Thickend
description: A parry made without a flicker of breath turns the strike while the student stays still.

name: Vigor Clout
description: The blow falls from the stillness at the centre, unhurried and impossible to read.

name: Gloomclout
description: A hush of qi spreads from the club and presses the opponent's movement down to stillness.

name: Bulgepledge
description: The club hooks the opponent and swings him around the student like a ring about the calm centre.

name: Unbroken Girth
description: The student braces in perfect quiet, and the storm of blows breaks around him.

name: Sovereign Stout
description: At the instant the storm closes about him, a hammer falls on the nearest foe.

name: Tempestuous Knob
description: A ring of whirling qi leaves the club and strikes every foe around the student in one sweep.

name: Exalted Heartwood
description: After the long silence, all the field's weight falls in a single blow with no warning.

name: Vigor Roundhead
description: The school's own stroke, the calm centre turned into a falling blow weighted to the striker's realm.

name: Knobseal
description: The student plants himself against the high wind with the club low and weight forward.

name: Bedrock Wallop
description: A swift rap falls on the guard arm as clean and cold as high thin air.

name: Feather Burl
description: A surefooted pace along a narrow ridge brings the student to the opponent's side.

name: Bedrock Bludgeon
description: An overhead stroke gathers the push of the high wind into the club's fall.

name: Pealbulge
description: The club slopes like a ridgeline and a blow splits on it and passes by on both sides.

name: Thumpvow
description: The knob tears at an opponent's guard with a gale's force and pulls it open.

name: Prismbulge
description: At the crest of a charge the student braces, the club driven down and qi deep in the ground.

name: Matchless Wallop
description: The hammer falls with the Core's weight and the high gale's push behind it.

name: Tempestuous Stout
description: A great gathered sweep calls the highland gale across all the ground before the student.

name: Magmaburl
description: The Core draws the gale down from above, and it falls through the club upon the whole field.

name: Magnificent Bulge
description: The school's own greatest stroke, the high gale called down the club and weighted to the striker's realm.
